fill.$description: Tinted backgrounds for highlight zones — distinct from `surface.*` which covers opaque chrome. The status pairs (`subtle` / `bold`) replace the dozens of raw `*-50` / `*-500` references in badge / inline-alert / status-dot / snackbar / share-with-customer / card.

always-white.$description: Plain white fill that does NOT theme — stays white in dark mode. Used by the tile family.

teal.$description: Teal-tinted fill — used by share-with-customer surfaces and other agent-only callouts that should feel distinct from the info/blue family.
